```{r}
plot_lmer_interaction <- function(model, x_var, color_var, y_var, save_path = NULL, width = 8, height = 6) {
  require(ggplot2)
  require(effects)
  
  pred_data <- as.data.frame(Effect(c(color_var, x_var), model))
  
  p <- ggplot(pred_data, aes_string(x = x_var, y = "fit", color = color_var, group = color_var)) +
    geom_line(size = 1) +
    geom_ribbon(aes_string(ymin = "lower", ymax = "upper", fill = color_var), alpha = 0.2) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(x = x_var, y = y_var, color = color_var, fill = color_var) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
  
  if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    ggsave(save_path, p, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
  }
  
  return(p)
}

  # Simpler cross-validation function
  cv_lmer <- function(formula, data, k=5) {
      set.seed(123)
      folds <- createFolds(1:nrow(data), k=k)
      mse <- numeric(k)
      
      for(i in 1:k) {
          train <- data[-folds[[i]], ]
          test <- data[folds[[i]], ]
          fit <- lmer(formula, data=train)
          pred <- predict(fit, newdata=test, allow.new.levels=TRUE)
          mse[i] <- mean((test[[varush]] - pred)^2, na.rm=TRUE)
      }
      return(mean(mse))
  }
```


```{r}
# Define the components and variables
input_dir = "D:\\OExpOut\\adapt_res\\results\\lme"
output_dir = "D:\\OExpOut\\adapt_res\\results\\lme"

components <- c("N100","P2", "N350")
variables <- c("amplitude") # , "latency"
sov_of_interest <- c('wn', 'N1', 'N2', 'N3', 'REM')  # c('wn', 'N1', 'N2', 'N3', 'REM')       c('tREM', 'pREM')
output_prefix <- "res_wnN123REM_Bl0_"  #  "res_wnN123REM_Bl0_"   "res_rems_Bl0_" 
 
for (component in components) {
  data_table <- read.csv(paste0(input_dir, "\\component_amplitudes.csv"))
  data_table <- data_table[data_table$comp == component, ]
  data_table <- data_table[!is.na(data_table$is_peak), ]
  data_table <- data_table[data_table$sov %in% sov_of_interest, ]
  # Convert variables to factors:
  data_table$sov <- factor(data_table$sov, levels = sov_of_interest, ordered = FALSE)
  data_table$sub <- factor(data_table$sub, ordered = FALSE)
  data_table$trial_pos <- factor(substr(data_table$cond, nchar(data_table$cond), nchar(data_table$cond)))
  data_table$is_peak <- factor(data_table$is_peak, levels = c(0, 1), ordered = FALSE) 
  data_table$amplitude <- as.numeric(data_table$amplitude) 
  
  # data_table <- data_table[data_table$trial_pos != "4", ]
  
  for (varush in variables) {
    output_file_name <- paste0(output_prefix, component, "_", varush, "_results.txt")

    sink(paste0(output_dir, "\\", output_file_name)) # Redirect output to the file
    
    initial_rows <- nrow(data_table)
    initial_subs <- unique(data_table$sub)
    
    # # Track outlier removals
    # std_to_remove_outliers <- 3
    # outlier_filtered <- data_table %>%
    #   group_by(sov) %>%
    #   mutate(mean_varush = mean(.data[[varush]], na.rm = TRUE),
    #          sd_varush = sd(.data[[varush]], na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    #   filter(abs(.data[[varush]] - mean_varush) <= std_to_remove_outliers * sd_varush) %>%
    #   ungroup()
    # outliers_removed <- initial_rows - nrow(outlier_filtered)
    # outlier_removed_rows <- anti_join(data_table, outlier_filtered)
    # outlier_removed_subs <- unique(outlier_removed_rows$sub)
    # data_table = outlier_filtered
    # cat(sprintf("\nRows removed:\n- %d outliers (>%d SD) from %d subjects: %s\n",
    #     outliers_removed,
    #     std_to_remove_outliers,
    #     length(outlier_removed_subs),
    #     paste(outlier_removed_subs, collapse=", ")))
  
    # Track peak removals
    peak_filtered <- data_table[data_table$is_peak == 1, ]
    peaks_removed <- nrow(data_table) - nrow(peak_filtered)
    peak_removed_rows <- anti_join(data_table, peak_filtered)
    peak_removed_subs <- unique(peak_removed_rows$sub)
  
    cat(sprintf("\nRows removed:\n - %d non-peaks from %d subjects: %s\n",
        peaks_removed,
        length(peak_removed_subs),
        paste(peak_removed_subs, collapse=", ")))
  
    data_table <- peak_filtered
    
        
    cat("\n==============================\n==============================\n")
    form_0 = as.formula(paste0(varush, " ~ (1|sub)"))
    form_sov <- as.formula(paste0(varush, " ~ sov + (1|sub)"))
    form_trial <- as.formula(paste0(varush, " ~ trial_pos + (1|sub)"))
    form_add <- as.formula(paste0(varush, " ~ sov + trial_pos + (1|sub)"))
    form_int <- as.formula(paste0(varush, " ~ sov * trial_pos + (1|sub)"))
    m0 <- lmer(form_0, data=data_table)
    m_trial <- lmer(form_trial, data=data_table)
    m_sov  <- lmer(form_sov, data=data_table)
    m_add <- lmer(form_add, data=data_table)
    m_int <- lmer(form_int, data=data_table)
    plot_lmer_interaction(m_int, "trial_pos", "sov", varush, paste0(output_dir, "\\Bl0_", component,"_",varush, "_trial_pos_sov_interaction_plot.png"))
    
    
    # Compare models
    cat("\n_____________Anova Comparisons:_____________\n")
    print(anova(m0, m_trial))
    cat("\n\n")
    print(anova(m0, m_sov))
    cat("\n\n")
    print(anova(m_sov, m_trial))
    cat("\n\n")
    print(anova(m_sov, m_int))
    cat("\n\n")
    print(anova(m_trial, m_int))
    cat("\n\n")
    print(anova(m_add, m_int))

    cat("\n_____________bayesfactor Comparisons:_____________\n")
    cat("Interpertation: 1: no evidance, >0.3 for model H0, +3 for model H1\n\n")
    print(bayesfactor_models(list(m0,m_sov)))
    cat("\n\n")
    print(bayesfactor_models(list(m0,m_trial)))
    cat("\n\n")
    print(bayesfactor_models(list(m_sov,m_trial)))
    cat("\n\n")
    print(bayesfactor_models(list(m_sov,m_int)))
    cat("\n\n")
    print(bayesfactor_models(list(m_trial,m_int)))
    cat("\n\n")
    print(bayesfactor_models(list(m_add,m_int)))



    cat("\n============================================================\n")
  
    # Cross-validation
    cat("\n\n_____________Cross-validation Analysis:_____________\n")
    cv_m1 <- cv_lmer(form_trial, data_table)
    cv_m2 <- cv_lmer(form_sov, data_table)
    cv_m3 <- cv_lmer(form_int, data_table)
    cat(sprintf("CV MSE - trial model: %.2f\n", cv_m1))
    cat(sprintf("CV MSE - sov model: %.2f\n", cv_m2))
    cat(sprintf("CV MSE - interaction model: %.2f\n", cv_m3))

    
    # Stop redirecting output to the file
    sink()
  }
}
```
